title: JARCOS: giant wordmark with project images swapping inside the O
note: A full-bleed 'JARCOS' wordmark (Inter Display 600, black on white) with a portrait image tile sitting over the 'CO', so the letters cut through it. Hovering the wordmark swaps the tile to another project image (Framer site; the cursor is a small dot with a difference blend). After that the page drops to black and the work is a plain 2-up grid with name left and discipline right in 12px. Worth reusing: one image moment locked into the type, instead of a reel of videos.
